name: field
title: Field
description: A label, hint and error row around any control, wired for screen readers; plus the label, description and error parts.

when: Wrapping a control the library does not provide, so it matches the other fields.

instead.when: A text input is enough; it has the field row built in.

builtIn: Label, hint and error are linked to the control with htmlFor, aria-describedby and aria-invalid.
youProvide: A control with a matching `id`, or a single child Field can give one to.

Field.name: htmlFor
Field.description:
Control id for the label. Optional: when omitted, Field generates one and
injects it onto a single-element child. Field is for a control the library does not
provide (a native input, a third-party widget) and for `InputGroup` with `InputGroupInput`,
which forwards it to its input. The library's own fields (TextField, Select…) carry their
own label, hint and error, so they do not go inside a Field.

Field.name: errorMessage
Field.description: What went wrong and what to do; shown under the control and announced.

Field.name: description
Field.description: A line of help under the control (hidden while there is an error).

Field.name: requiredClassName
Field.description:
Class for the required "*" asterisk. Defaults to the danger text token; a brand
marketing form can override it without forking this component.

FieldLabel.name: isRequired
FieldLabel.description: Shows `*` in `ds-text-danger` (hidden from screen readers: the control is `aria-required`).

FieldLabel.name: isOptional
FieldLabel.description: Shows "(optional)" in the provider locale; use it when most fields of the form are required.
